query_features: sklearn HashingVectorizer: word unigrams+bigrams, l2, alternate_sign=False
reward: sum of observed component rewards; discount once per pipeline decision

split_grouping.rule: Union of shared provenance identifiers and normalized exact query matches
split_grouping.warning: Semantic paraphrase overlap is not detected; validation may be empty if all groups are connected or needed for action coverage

assumptions: Maximum 2 pipeline decisions per candidate query/history segment.
Segment boundaries inferred from query, provenance, and history resets.
An initially empty evidence store and complete execution of inferred action blocks are assumed.
No-marker segments are treated as one inferred initial pipeline selection, including possible fixed workflows.
At the round limit assign timeout, even if finalizer is last; earlier finalizer endings are terminal.
Unresolved early endings, component failures, and horizon/history inconsistencies are excluded.
